title: Ray Bradbury BBC Radio
identity_notes: Curated 21-item BBC Ray Bradbury radio-drama collection spanning 1962-2014. It combines standalone BBC adaptations with the 12-episode 1995-97 Tales of the Bizarre run and later Radio 4 Dangerous Visions productions. Frozen rows have no broadcast dates; historical production dates are represented additively in archive profiles and claims.

eras.label: 1982-1991 BBC adaptations
eras.notes: World Service and Radio 4 adaptations bridge the early productions and later anthology run.

eras.label: Tales of the Bizarre

eras.label: Modern BBC Radio 4 revivals

historical_context.title: Bradbury and BBC radio across five decades
historical_context.description: The collection demonstrates repeated BBC return to Bradbury material over more than fifty years, using several services and production styles.

historical_context.title: Early BBC Ray Bradbury radio adaptations
historical_context.description: The frozen collection begins with There Will Come Soft Rains on the BBC Third Programme and Leviathan 99 on BBC Radio 3.

historical_context.title: BBC Bradbury productions in 1982
historical_context.description: The Emissary aired on BBC World Service in March 1982 and Fahrenheit 451 on BBC Radio 4 in November 1982.

historical_context.title: Ray Bradbury’s Tales of the Bizarre
historical_context.description: BBC Radio 4 broadcast twelve Bradbury adaptations under Tales of the Bizarre across 1995-97.

historical_context.title: Dangerous Visions Bradbury adaptations
historical_context.description: BBC Radio 4’s 2014 Dangerous Visions season included The Illustrated Man and The Martian Chronicles one week apart.
